# Terratrail

> Terratrail is an operations platform for Nigerian land sales and real estate
> businesses. It tracks properties, installment-based subscriptions, payment
> reminders, realtor commissions, and gives customers a self-service portal —
> replacing spreadsheets and group chats for estate operators.

Terratrail is registered as compliant with the Nigeria Data Protection
Regulation (NDPR) 2019, issued under the Nigeria Data Protection Act.

## Pages

- [Home](https://terratrail.app/): Product overview — installment tracking, payment reminders, realtor commissions, customer portal.
- [Pricing](https://terratrail.app/pricing): Plans and pricing, billed quarterly, biannually, or annually. A Free plan is available.
- [About](https://terratrail.app/about): Why Terratrail was built and who it serves.
- [Contact](https://terratrail.app/contact): How to reach the Terratrail team for sales, support, or demos.
- [Privacy Policy](https://terratrail.app/privacy): How Terratrail collects, uses, and protects personal data, including NDPR-specific data subject rights.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://terratrail.app/terms): Terms governing use of the Terratrail platform.
